mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, category_id, name, description, price, duration, status, resource_type, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM services WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY name
SELECT FROM services WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY name
SELECT FROM services WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY name
mapper.update: UPDATE services SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, duration = #{duration}, status = #{status}, resource_type = #{resourceType}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT sc.name as category_name, COALESCE(stats.order_count, 0) as order_count, COALESCE(stats.total_revenue, 0) as total_revenue FROM service_categories sc LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.category_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) as order_count, COALESCE(SUM(os.price * os.quantity), 0) as total_revenue FROM services s INNER JOIN order_services os ON s.id = os.service_id INNER JOIN orders o ON os.order_id = o.id AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.payment_status = 'paid' AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY s.category_id ) stats ON sc.id = stats.category_id WHERE sc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sc.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY COALESCE(stats.total_revenue, 0) DESC, sc.name

SELECT s.name as service_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN os.id END) as order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN os.price * os.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) as total_revenue FROM services s LEFT JOIN order_services os ON s.id = os.service_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON os.order_id = o.id AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.payment_status = 'paid' AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY s.id, s.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN os.id END) > 0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, s.name LIMIT #{limit}
